title: Rename match arm 'v4 => v4' to 'other => other'
description: In session.rs:184 and config.rs:804, the wildcard arm is written as 'v4 => v4'. The name implies the arm only captures V4, but that is enforced by the type system, not the pattern. A reader must stop and verify IpAddr has only two variants. The idiomatic form is 'other => other'. Both sites are resolved when the normalize_client_ip helper is extracted (companion issue stoa-6b4887c1.2).
notes: SEC7 calibration: opinion/style. IpAddr has exactly two variants and this is stable in Rust's std. The name 'v4' is technically misleading (compiler does not enforce the name implies a type filter), but a reader checking IpAddr's definition immediately resolves any confusion. The real fix is the extraction in 1onm.2, which eliminates both occurrences of this arm. As a standalone rename it has no engineering consequence.
